primary_additional.name: open-epg-pr
primary_additional._comment: Primary desc source for all matched channels — open-epg desc wins over provider desc. channel_id_map injects .pr Spanish desc into matching .us slots (DINO has no PR descriptions)

primary_additional.name: epgenius-6
primary_additional._comment: EPGenius #6 (GanjaRelease) — IDs match provider EPG; adds ~197 allowlist channels over provider EPG, 11-day window. ~15k channels, filtered by allowlist (no bypass_filter)

primary_additional.name: epgshare01-us-locals
primary_additional._comment: epgshare01 US local stations (Gracenote-style ids, updated daily, 4-day window). Only channels in channel_id_map are used: 5 PR stations (backup if open-epg is stale) + US/CA locals not covered by provider/epg6. Mapped by id; DT2 subchannels excluded on purpose.

primary_additional.name: iptv-epg-custom
primary_additional._comment: Replaces iptv-epg-us (2026-10-18). 75 MB gz / 641 MB xml, over Node's 512 MB string limit, so it is filtered while decompressing (stream_filter) and cut to max_days ahead (workflow runs every 12 h). Allowlist/provider channels always kept; other channels with a .us/.ca/.pr/.es suffix kept only for programmes with a description (extra_suffixes).

primary_additional.name: epg-pw-us
primary_additional._comment: Large US EPG — covers Telemundo affiliates (WNJU, WSCV) not in iptv-epg-us | disabled 2026-10-17: adds 0-3 allowlist channels over provider+epg6+open-epg, costs 30-60 MB download

primary_additional.name: epg-pw-es
primary_additional._comment: Spain EPG — schedule + descriptions for Spain allowlist channels

primary_additional.name: epg-pw-uk
primary_additional._comment: UK EPG — schedule + descriptions for UK allowlist channels (Sky Cinema etc)

secondary.name: open-epg-pr
secondary._comment: Priority 0 — best PR channel descriptions; channelId-keyed so no cross-channel pollution

secondary.name: open-epg
secondary._comment: Priority 1 — PR channel title-based description fallback for provider-covered channels

secondary.name: iptv-epg-us
secondary._comment: Priority 3 — fill gaps not in epg2 | disabled 2026-10-18: expands to 540 MB, replaced by iptv-epg-custom
